content.value: Write down five applications of accelerometer. A piezoelectric crystal having dimensions of 5 mm×5 mm×1.25 mm and a voltage sensitivity of 0.055 Vm/N is used for vibration measurement. Calculate the force of seismic mass if the voltage developed is 100 volt.
